correctness.rationale: Massri 2026 Theorem 1.1 yields an integral codimension-three CI for every odd r>=7. The exact symplectic moment-map differential has kernel dual to infinitesimal stabilizers; none exist outside pure powers. The explicit transverse antidiagonal residual has a full-rank Hessian in r-4 variables and weighted degree r+1. A vanishing residual coefficient would produce singular points off the pure-power curve, contradicting the proved global rank criterion. This reconstructs the analytic A_{(r-1)/2} form, with transverse Jacobian algebra dimension (r-1)/2. Pure-Python rational code checks seven finite degrees as corroboration only.
